response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount END) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), base AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines FROM cat), kept AS (SELECT c.avg_rel_overspend, c.line_count FROM cat c JOIN base b ON c.line_count > b.avg_lines) SELECT AVG(k.avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(k.line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(k.line_count - b.avg_lines) AS avg_excess_line_count FROM kept k CROSS JOIN base b;

assumptions.assumption: Each budget line counts toward its category's line count, including lines with a NULL spent or amount; missing values are skipped only in the relative overspend average.
Lines with amount = 0 are excluded from the relative overspend because the division is undefined; they still count as lines.
The per-category average line count is the total number of budget lines divided by the number of category groups, and a NULL category forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only lines with usable values (non-NULL spent and amount, nonzero amount) in the line count, so the count matches the lines that feed the overspend average.
alternatives.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount END) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 THEN 1 END) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), base AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines FROM cat), kept AS (SELECT c.avg_rel_overspend, c.line_count FROM cat c JOIN base b ON c.line_count > b.avg_lines) SELECT AVG(k.avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(k.line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(k.line_count - b.avg_lines) AS avg_excess_line_count FROM kept k CROSS JOIN base b;

alternatives.interpretation: Leave out budget lines with no category, so the NULL category does not count as one of the categories in the per-category average.
